name: SDD_WANTS_ASSISTANCE
description: Stores information about whether the patient would like resource recommendations for SDOH domains.

columns.name: SDOH_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the social driver data record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: WANTS_ASSISTANCE_YN
columns.description: Tracks whether the patient was documented as wanting assistance with needs in an SDOH domain.

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant a patient was documented as wanting or not wanting assistance. This instant stores when the data was written to SDD. If the data was filed via a flowsheet, it may not match the taken or recorded instant. The intent of this item is to indicate when a user could have first viewed this status in SDOH views for the patient. To find when the flowsheet was filed, items 904 and 905 can be used to find the linked flowsheet data.

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_USER_ID
columns.description: The user who documented a patient as wanting assistance

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: How a patients decision on whether they want assistance was documented

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_FSD_ID
columns.description: The FSD record where flowsheet data that indicated a patient would or would not like assistance was documented

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_FSD_LINE
columns.description: The FSD line where flowsheet data that indicated a patient would or would not like assistance was documented

columns.name: WANTS_ASST_PAT_REP_YN
columns.description: Whether documentation that a patient would like assistance was patient reported. This item tracks whether the information was collected via MyChart.
